## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Es liegt mir am Herzen** — [ess leekt meer am HAIR-tsen] — *It's close to my heart / It matters deeply to me*
2. **Ich brauche einen klaren Kopf** — [ikh BROW-khuh EYE-nen KLAH-ren kopf] — *I need a clear head*
3. **Das ergibt Sinn** — [dass air-GEEPT zin] — *That makes sense*
